groups.title: Shared supplementary subjects and have

groups.writingJob: Require a real shared referent between the supplementary subject and principal subject, keep person-number agreement as evidence rather than identity, and recognize the licensed locative have construction without inventing a have verb.

groups.decisionSplit: The user chooses shared subject supplementation when another role is possible; the application validates referent identity and derives the have interpretation from the entered clause structure.

groups.title: Shared supplementary objects and possessors
groups.proposal: Bind the supplement subject to a licensed principal object or possessor and block an English-style direct possessor-as-modifier analysis.
groups.writingJob: Expose object or possessor only when the typed principal licenses it, unify the selected head with the supplementary subject, and reject structurally impossible head roles.
groups.readingJob: Guide the reader to identify supplementary objects and possessors through their personal-pronoun cross-reference rather than English word order.
groups.decisionSplit: The user chooses object or possessor only when both readings are structurally possible; otherwise the application derives the only licensed role.
groups.controlPolicy: Reuse the conditional head-role choice and hide impossible roles; do not add a general object or possessor switch.

groups.title: Recursive supplementation
groups.proposal: Build an acyclic hierarchy in which a supplement can itself be principal to another supplement.
groups.writingJob: Compose repeated supplementation through typed continuation frames while preserving each complete clause and every reference link.
groups.readingJob: Guide the reader through nested possession and reference chains from the outer principal through each supplement.
groups.decisionSplit: The user chooses which completed composition is reused as principal or supplement; the application validates the acyclic hierarchy.
groups.controlPolicy: Reuse the existing composition recapture actions; do not expose recursion depth as a number control.

groups.title: Reference contact, demonstratives, and ambiguity

groups.controlPolicy: Reuse conditional role choices; do not infer a role from stem identity, word order, or traditional fused spelling.
